attractions.name: Banjosa Lake
attractions.description: A scenic artificial lake surrounded by pine forests, popular for boating and picnics.

attractions.name: Toli Pir
attractions.description: A high-altitude meadow offering panoramic views of surrounding valleys and, on clear days, distant snow-capped peaks.

transportation.route: Local taxi to Banjosa Lake/Toli Pir
transportation.notes: Recommended for reaching the lake and mountain meadow areas

weather_info.climate_type: Humid subtropical highland climate, cool and green given the pine forest surroundings
weather_info.avoid_months: Heavy winter snowfall can restrict access to Toli Pir

seasonal_notes.avg_condition: Cold, occasional snowfall, especially at Toli Pir

travel_tips.tip: Rawalakot is reached via a scenic but winding mountain road from Islamabad -- allow extra travel time compared to flat-terrain routes.
Hire a local taxi for trips to Banjosa Lake and Toli Pir, since both involve mountain roads best driven by someone familiar with them.
Check road conditions before heading to Toli Pir in winter, as snow can temporarily close the route.
Visit Banjosa Lake in the early morning or late afternoon for the most peaceful atmosphere and best light for photos.

history.founded: A historic town in the Poonch region, with settlement dating back centuries
history.city_history: Rawalakot serves as the main town of the Poonch district of Azad Jammu & Kashmir, an area with a long history tied to the broader Kashmir region before the 1947 partition. Today it's known primarily as a gateway to the scenic lakes and meadows of the surrounding hills.
history.province_history: Azad Jammu & Kashmir is a self-governing territory of Pakistan, formed in 1947 in the aftermath of the partition of British India and the subsequent Kashmir conflict, distinct from the neighboring Indian-administered Jammu and Kashmir.
